The '''Battle of Coruscant''' was one of the final battles in the [[Fel Empire]]'s [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==The battle==
A part of the fighting involved an attack on the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]]. It was a feint designed to draw off [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces from aiding at the [[Battle of Caamas]]; the Jedi were said to have "blunted" the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] attack at high cost to themselves.<ref name="Legacy 21" />

==Aftermath==
After [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Piers Petan]] surrendered at [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]],<ref name="Legacy 21" /> the Temple fell to Sith forces regardless. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Azlyn Rae]] was believed dead. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] offered the Jedi a chance to surrender and join his [[Imperial Knight]]s.<ref name="Legacy 24" /> While some accepted, others refused and regrouped at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Academy]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Emperor Fel ordered his forces to leave the Jedi alone.<ref name="Legacy 8" /> However, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rulf Yage]]<ref name="Legacy 39">[[Legacy (2006) 39|''Legacy'' (2006) 39]]</ref> and [[Fist]] [[Darth Nihl]], who served [[Darth Krayt]] instead, ignored his orders and carried out an [[Massacre at Ossus|attack]] that left the [[New Jedi Order]] in ruins, scattering the few survivors.<ref name="Legacy 1" />
